title: 第六千三百二十一章 王特遇险第六千三百二十章 黄金之路
content_zh:
一众修士们好奇不已，日后要闯黄金之路的王特，如今却还只是一个灵魂一段的修士。
当然，这个修为提升的速度已经堪称逆天了，叶枫离开时王特还只是灵尊境，如今已经是灵魂境。
叶枫站在广安郡的天穹之上，带着何楚楚，玄夜灵虎一同俯瞰着下方陷入苦战的王特。
“这就是主子的弟子，看着没什么特别之处嘛。”
何楚楚挑眉说道，她并非贬低王特，只因她自身就是一位绝世天才，体内还有着地母传承，在叶枫相助下成为灵皇强者。
何楚楚的年纪大不了王特几岁，却已是灵皇修为，以她的眼光看待王特，的确是平平无奇。
“楚楚，主子的弟子可不简单，你别看他修为低，但底子扎实，而且潜力无限。”
玄夜灵虎开口说道，头乃是玄夜冥虎转世的消息，叶枫也告知它了，并且它还感应到自己体内隐藏的力量，甚至恢复了部分前世记忆，因此眼界也是提高很多。
正因如此，玄夜灵虎才看出王特不凡，他发现王特体内有着一股玄妙气息，与天道呼应，很像是传说中天道之子的特点。
“王特啊，他只是起步太晚，不过他的确潜力无限。”
叶枫淡然的笑了笑。
下方面，王特正在与一群修士激战，这群修士共二十人，其中有三位灵魂境，两位灵魂二段，一位灵魂七段。
这些人都是广安郡城赵家的人，为首的灵魂七段，便是赵家家主赵野，而两位灵魂二段之一，便是赵野主子，赵狂。
原来，这赵狂修炼到灵魂二段，想到王特屡次对自己不敬，他雇人刺杀王特也失败，因此便又生出对王特要出手的心思，就派人调查王特。
这一调查不要紧，还真让赵狂发现惊天秘密，王特只用短短时间，就修炼到灵魂境，如此提升速度堪称逆天。
赵狂觉得王特要么天资绝世，要么就获得非凡机缘，若是天资绝世，那他雇人刺杀王特的事情被王特知晓，必然要被清算。
而若是王特获得非凡机缘，那这份机缘，他赵家未必不能享有。
因此，赵狂找到父亲赵野，说明此事，并提议杀死王特，若有机缘就抢过来，没有就当抹除一个风险，怎么都不亏。
赵野认可赵狂的注意，特地设局，抓了一群良家女子当引子，将王特引到了广安郡城西边的山坳里，在此地展开伏杀。
“赵狂，你这个混账，你刺杀我，我还没和你算账，你竟然又来找事！”

王特口中低喝，手中金星剑不断斩出，明明是灵魂一段境界，却将赵狂这个灵魂二段打的无法招架。
只是片刻功夫，赵狂就满身伤痕，另一位灵魂二段，赵家客卿刘慎见状连忙出手相助。
“小子，不要猖狂，看剑！”
刘慎原是一位散修，依靠着意外获得的一门灵王级剑法，千秋剑在江湖上闯出不小名声，被誉为千秋剑宗。
这刘慎的千秋剑法已经是登峰造极，大宗师境界，但他对上王特之后却是面色大变，连连暴退。
只因王特的剑法，还在刘慎之上，这也是因为王特的剑法都是叶枫传授，远非千秋剑法可比。
“怪物，真是个怪物。”
眨眼之间，刘慎与赵狂一样，也变得满身伤痕，而且因为他于王特比拼剑法，受到的压制更强，伤势比赵狂还要严重一些。
“你们两个废物，联手也不是我的对手！”
王特冷笑连连，他一边对付赵狂二人，一边紧盯着赵野。
content_en:
All the monks were curious. Wang Te, who would pursue the golden road in the future, was now just a monk with a soul.
Of course, the speed of this cultivation level improvement is already incredible. When Ye Feng left, Wang Te was only in the spirit realm, but now he is in the soul realm.
Ye Feng stood on the sky in Guang'an County, taking He Chuchu and Xuanye Linghu with him to look down at Wang Te who was locked in a bitter battle below.
"This is my master's disciple. There doesn't seem to be anything special about him."
He Chuchu raised her eyebrows and said that she was not belittling Wang Te, just because she was a peerless genius in her own right, with the inheritance of the Earth Mother in her body, and with the help of Ye Feng, she became a powerful Spirit Emperor.
He Chuchu was not much older than Wang Te, but he was already a Spirit Emperor. From her perspective, Wang Te was indeed ordinary.
"Chu Chu, Master's disciple is not simple. Although he has a low level of cultivation, he has a solid foundation and unlimited potential."
Xuan Ye Linghu said, the first thing he heard was the news of Xuan Ye Minghu's reincarnation. Ye Feng also informed it, and it also sensed the power hidden in its body and even recovered some of its past life memories, so its vision was greatly improved.
Because of this, Xuanye Linghu saw that Wang Te was extraordinary. He found that Wang Te had a mysterious aura in his body, which echoed the way of heaven, and was very similar to the characteristics of the legendary son of heaven.
"Wang Te, he just started too late, but he does have unlimited potential."
Ye Feng smiled calmly.
Below, Wang Te is fighting fiercely with a group of monks. There are twenty monks in this group, three of whom are in the soul realm, two are in the second level of soul, and one is in the seventh level of soul.
These people are all members of the Zhao family in Guang'an County. The leader of the seventh-stage soul is Zhao Ye, the head of the Zhao family, and one of the two second-stage souls is Zhao Ye's master, Zhao Kuang.
It turned out that Zhao Kuang had cultivated to the second level of soul. Thinking that Wang Te had been disrespectful to him many times and that he hired people to assassinate Wang Te but failed, he thought of taking action against Wang Te again and sent people to investigate Wang Te.
This investigation didn't matter, it really allowed Zhao Kuang to discover a shocking secret. It only took Wang Te a short time to cultivate to the soul level. Such an improvement speed was unparalleled.
Zhao Kuang felt that Wang Te was either extremely talented or had extraordinary opportunities. If he was extremely talented, then he would definitely be liquidated if Wang Te knew about his hiring of people to assassinate Wang Te.
And if Wang Te gets an extraordinary opportunity, then his Zhao family may not be able to enjoy this opportunity.
Therefore, Zhao Kuang went to his father Zhao Ye to explain the matter and proposed to kill Wang Te. If there was a chance, he would snatch it away. If not, he would eliminate a risk and there would be no loss at all.
Zhao Ye recognized Zhao Kuang's attention and set up a special trap. He captured a group of good women as lures and led Wang Te to the mountain col to the west of Guang'an County, where he launched an ambush.
"Zhao Kuang, you bastard, you assassinated me, and I haven't settled the score with you yet, and you're here to cause trouble again!"
Wang Te shouted in a low voice, and kept slashing out the Venus Sword in his hand. He was obviously in the first-level soul realm, but he beat Zhao Kuang, the second-level soul, into a state of being unable to parry.
In just a moment, Zhao Kuang was covered in scars. Another second-level soul, Liu Shen, the guest of the Zhao family, saw this and quickly came to help.
"Boy, don't be so arrogant, watch the sword!"
Liu Shen was originally a casual cultivator. Relying on a spiritual king-level swordsmanship he accidentally acquired, Qianqiu Sword became famous in the world and was known as the Qianqiu Sword Sect.
Liu Shen's Qianqiu swordsmanship has reached its peak, the Grand Master level, but when he faced Wang Te, his expression changed drastically and he retreated violently.
Just because Wang Te's swordsmanship is still superior to Liu Shen's, it is also because Wang Te's swordsmanship was taught by Ye Feng and is far from comparable to Qianqiu's swordsmanship.
"A monster, what a monster."
In the blink of an eye, Liu Shen, like Zhao Kuang, also became covered in scars. Moreover, because of his swordsmanship competition with Wang Te, he was more suppressed and his injuries were more serious than Zhao Kuang's.
"You two losers are no match for me even if you work together!"
Wang Te sneered again and again.Fu and Zhao Kuang both stared at Zhao Ye closely.
